Comments/details: Built-in grid supports cyweb boundingBox 1000x1000, padding 30 and condense toggle. Shared completion listener still needs migration.
Built-in circle supports radius 1000 and spacingFactor 1. Recheck positions and overlap spacing after porting the common adapter.

Built-in exists and spacingFactor works, but v4 changes overlap/ring packing. Cyweb passes width/height 1000; both installed v3 and v4 declare but do not read those fields. Use boundingBox if a fixed area is intended. This option issue predates v4.
Not ported. Current name cose throws. v4 force is a different algorithm, not full CoSE compatibility.

Cyweb exposes nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels, numIter, gravity, initialTemp, coolingFactor and minTemp; also sets nodeOverlap and boundingBox. Do not forward these wholesale to force. Redesign and validate the controls against force options.
cytoscape-biological-flow is registered as biological-flow (UI/model key bionodes). v4 has no use() registry or this built-in. Port to LayoutContext or evaluate flow; equivalent output is unverified.

cyweb calls cyLayout.on(layoutstop) before run(). v4 layout instances are not emitters. Attach a one-shot core listener before run, or use the appropriate completion API. This blocks every cyjs layout even when its algorithm exists.
Temporary headless core, node/edge definitions, position collection and destroy are supported. No WebGPU needed for this path.
Current Layout menu and layout API pass the target network nodes/edges, not selected-only collections. The engine can accept arrays but that alone is not evidence of a selected-subgraph UI feature.

Below 1000 total elements cyweb chooses G6 gForce, or G6 dagre for hierarchies. At/above 1000 it chooses cyjs grid, subject to the configured maximum. Migrating CoSE alone would not migrate the default layout path.
Scaling modifies cyweb view-model positions; cyjs displays those coordinates. This is not a cyjs layout extension.
Cyweb uses its Cosmos engine, not the cyjs CoSE implementation. Preserve this engine and adapt only renderer position writes if necessary.
Dagre, radial and gForce are provided by AntV/G6. v4 flow/radial are optional alternatives, not prerequisites or proven replacements.
D3 computes and renders the packing. Cyjs supplies roots/outgoers for the hierarchy data builder; those traversals are separately inventoried.
Cyweb inserts saved x/y in element definitions and later writes positions. It does not explicitly run the cyjs preset layout in the main renderer. v4 accepts positions and also has preset.
No production calls found for cyjs breadthfirst or random, nor a registered fCoSE/Cola/ELK extension. Do not treat these as cyweb migration requirements.
createCyjsDataMapper returns an ordered array of selector/style blocks; v4 rejects it. Build nodes/edges/parents/core groups with declarative state/data mappings.

Cyweb materializes visual values in element data then emits data(key) strings. Replace numeric/colour/enum strings with {data:key}. Label strings retain compatibility. Font strings can silently become literal font names.

Vizmapper evaluates these in cyweb before applyViewModel writes values to cyjs. Keeping that evaluation avoids changing cyweb interpolation semantics. Only the final cyjs data-mapper bridge must change; adopting v4 scales is optional.
Style sets, switching, persistence and undo are implemented in cyweb. v4 can replace the active sheet, but its sheet swap discards live bypasses unless included again.
data(key,value), removeData and automatic mapped-style updates remain available. The view data are computed by cyweb; network attributes live in separate tables.
hover and edge-creation-target classes drive highlights. v4 removes addClass/removeClass and class selectors. Use element data flags and case mappers.
Both class highlights use underlay-shape roundrectangle. v4 rejects it; spell round-rectangle even after replacing classes.
Underlay colour, padding, opacity and canonical round-rectangle are available. Rebuild the activation condition using data or hover state.
Cyweb offers rectangle, diamond, ellipse, hexagon, octagon, parallelogram, round-rectangle, triangle and vee. It translates parallelogram to rhomboid. All resulting canonical v4 shapes exist.
nodeHeight maps to height. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
nodeWidth maps to width. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
nodeBackgroundColor maps to background-color. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
nodeOpacity maps to background-opacity. v4 folds channel opacity into colour alpha at write time; visual channel is supported, but readback and update order need checking.
nodeBorderColor maps to border-color. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
solid/dotted/dashed/double are rendered. Double-border gap compositing differs: v4 can show a crossing edge beneath the gap, where v3 erases to the background. Exact visual parity is not complete.
nodeBorderWidth maps to border-width. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
nodeBorderOpacity maps to border-opacity. v4 folds channel opacity into colour alpha at write time; visual channel is supported, but readback and update order need checking.

nodeLabelFontSize maps to font-size. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
Cyweb maps font-family per node/edge. v4 permits one global constant font face per instance; mapped fonts are rejected. Preserve mixed per-element fonts only with a separate rendering solution.
Special converter produces text-halign, text-valign, text-margin-x/y and text-justification. All are supported. Preserve cyweb anchor/offset translation; defaults differ if omitted.
Cyweb converts degrees to radians and supports autorotation. v4 supports numeric text-rotation and autorotate. Preserve that unit conversion.
nodeLabelOpacity maps to text-opacity. v4 folds channel opacity into colour alpha at write time; visual channel is supported, but readback and update order need checking.
Cyweb maps visibility to display, which v4 rejects. Reconcile mapped visibility and hide/show filters through structural show()/hide(). visibility:hidden only suppresses paint and is not equivalent.
Arbitrary per-element z-index is removed. v4 draws parents, edges, leaf nodes, then labels, with slot order within each stream. No equivalent for cyweb node/edge z-order controls.
Selection colour exists through case conditions with selected:true. Replace node:selected/edge:selected blocks and preserve selection priority over the normal data colour.
nodeMaxLabelWidth maps to text-max-width. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
edgeLineType maps to line-style. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
edgeLineColor maps to line-color. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.
edgeWidth maps to width. Property capability exists in v4; use the new stylesheet/data-mapper bridge.

Main stylesheet explicitly sets bezier, so retain it: v4 defaults to straight. Parallel-edge bundles and self-loop geometry exist.
Base node and edge sheets set text-wrap:wrap; max widths are separate visual properties. v4 supports wrapping.
Open arrow choices generate source-arrow-fill/target-arrow-fill data and canonical shapes. v4 supports filled/hollow at both endpoints.
Cyweb copies height to width and line colour to arrow colours in the view-to-data bridge. No special cyjs lock feature is required.

Cyweb emits pie-size, pie-start-angle, pie-hole and 16 pairs of pie-N-background-color/size. v4 rejects old names. Use chart:pie, chart-values, chart-colors, chart-size, chart-hole and chart-start-angle; verify size/angle units and percentage normalization.
URL/data-URI background-image, background-fit and crossorigin exist. Vizmapper drives them through data. Port mappings and verify actual image loading in a browser.

Element style bypass supports background-image/fit/opacity/crossorigin/containment. This capability exists, including SVG URLs, but stylesheet swap semantics break the current unchanged-image diff cache.

cyweb relies on v3 retaining node.style bypasses across cy.style swaps. v4 replaces bypasses with the sheet. Reapply even unchanged graphics, or merge bypasses into the new sheet; current reference/size diff can skip reapplication.

Model exposes nine image/chart slots with positions/sizes, but renderer gates on the first valid custom graphic and emits a single chart/image path. Do not interpret 27 placeholder pie-size mappings as 27 real rendered properties or claim nine simultaneous v3 layers. v4 native charts do not supply nine independent chart layers.
Rendered by cyweb on the bottom cytoscape-canvas layer, not a native network background-color stylesheet property. Replace the extension with a managed canvas/DOM background and account for exports.

Three cyCanvas layers (background/bottom/top) paint shapes, text and other CX annotations with 2D canvas transforms. No v4 core/renderer extension surface. Port layer ownership and redraw/resize synchronization outside the registry.
Canvas registers eagerly; SVG/PDF register lazily; biological-flow registers in layout module. v4 has no cytoscape.use. A dependency version swap alone cannot boot these modules.
Cyweb immediately stores a rendered core and creates annotation layers. v4 requires WebGPU and exposes ready as a Promise; await readiness and handle failure. There is no Canvas2D fallback.

Cyweb currently uses the v3 default Canvas2D renderer, giving it a rendering path without WebGPU. The current v4 branch supports WebGPU only, with no WebGL or Canvas2D fallback. User requirement: v4 needs WebGL support for widespread renderer availability. This is a renderer implementation gap, not just a cyweb adapter change.
Cyjs v3 API / properties: v3 default Canvas2D renderer; required v4 WebGL fallback

Comments/details: Cyweb passes hideEdgesOnViewport:true. v4 ignores this removed Canvas-era degradation option; WebGPU culling/LOD is the replacement, not identical behaviour.
Cyweb stores network topology in a headless core. v4 supports CPU-only headless use; styleEnabled:false is not needed to make it headless.
Explicit string IDs, nodes/edges definition arrays, source/target endpoints and initial positions are supported. Layout cores also omit edge IDs; v4 generates IDs for missing identifiers.
Used for deletion (#id lists and *), selected nodes and delegated node/edge events. v4 rejects selector strings. Use $id, query objects, predicates and collections.
getElementById/$id, empty, length/size, map/forEach and predicate filter support remain. Review mixed element iteration because v4 groups nodes before edges.
Cyjs v3 API / properties: $id; getElementById; empty; size; map; forEach; filter

Comments/details: App API moves edges atomically with edge.move({source,target}), preserving edge ID. v4 supports endpoint moves.

Deletion helpers inspect deletedElements.edges() and source()/target() after removal. v4 only guarantees cached id/group on terminal handles. Probe: source initially reads the old endpoint, then reads the replacement edge endpoint after slot reuse. Snapshot edge definitions before removal.
createFromCyJson calls store.json(cyJson), which v4 rejects. Replace with add(definitions) or constructor elements if this helper is used. Separate from CX2 conversion.
createCyJSON exports store.json(). Export exists in v4, but style/bypass format changes; do not assume a v3 JSON document schema for rendered cores.

No direct production usage found of cyjs PageRank, centrality, shortest-path or clustering APIs in cyweb. External apps may have their own usage, outside this repository inventory.
startBatch/endBatch reduce renderer updates around topology, view-model and graphics writes. Supported in v4.
select/unselect/selected and autounselectify exist. Preserve cyweb store synchronization; replace string selectors and selected-style blocks separately.
boxSelectionEnabled and boxend support exist. Cyweb collects selected nodes/edges after boxend. Recheck gesture selection geometry in the browser.
tap and cxttap remain in the emitted event vocabulary. Target/model/rendered positions support node creation, edge creation and context menus. Predicate delegation must replace selector strings.
grab and dragfree remain emitted. Position reads let cyweb record drag undo and update its view model.
mouseover/mouseout specifically survive v4, unlike raw mousedown/click aliases. Replace node, edge delegation strings and class mutations.
on(tap,node,handler), grab/dragfree node and mouseover/out node, edge use strings. v4 requires predicates; retain predicate identity for off().
on/off/removeAllListeners exist. Annotation reattachment must change because cyCanvas.resize comes from an incompatible extension and v4 does not implement namespaces.

Edge creation calls preventDefault/stopPropagation. v4 stopPropagation works, but preventDefault only reaches browser defaults; use explicit selection/grab toggles for graph interaction defaults. Verify the create-edge gesture.
Cyweb writes container.style.cursor in edge creation mode. v4 supplies canvas cursors that may override it. Set pointerCursors:false where cyweb owns the cursor or integrate with v4 state.
Collection show()/hide() exist as v4 structural visibility operations. Coordinate these with visual-property visibility, which can no longer use display mappings.
zoom, pan, fit, extent, width/height and container access exist. viewport events are emitted by v4 source even though the migration guide vocabulary list omits them.
Annotation layers redraw on render and resize. Native core events exist, but cyCanvas.resize is an extension signal and will need replacement.

Position and boundingBox APIs exist, including label-aware fitting. v4 stores Float32 coordinates rather than v3 Float64; extreme coordinate precision is not identical. Recheck viewport recovery and layout extents.
Main renderer, style-preview core, topology cores and temporary layout cores are supported lifecycles. v4 render instances each require GPU readiness.
cyweb exportPng returns a string synchronously. v4 png returns Promise<string|Blob>. Make renderer registry, export consumers and preview calls async; preserve full/maxWidth/maxHeight/bg options.
cytoscape-svg registers a v3 core extension and adds cy.svg. No native svg method or compatible registry found in v4. Requires an export implementation/port.

cytoscape-pdf-export registers a v3 core extension and adds cy.pdf with paper size/orientation/margins. No native pdf method or compatible registry found in v4. Requires an export implementation/port.
Offscreen rendered core reuses the same mapper and calls png for style thumbnails. Requires v4 sheet conversion, awaiting GPU readiness and PNG Promise, and checking the serial render queue.

Cyweb imports v3 Core, NodeSingular, EdgeSingular, CollectionReturnValue, EventObject and related declarations from @types/cytoscape. v4 ships its own differently shaped types. Recompile/adapt all integration types; no manifest changes made in this inventory.
